name: Five-Star Review, the Song
why_it_works: Reviews are proof, but nobody reads them. Singing a real customer's own words as a soulful verse makes social proof entertaining, and hearing a stranger's praise in a heartfelt voice feels more sincere than any claim the business makes about itself.

hook.pattern: Show the plain review text on screen, then a voice starts singing it word for word.
examples: {{reviewer_first_name}} left us a review. So we sang it.
We turned a five-star review into a song.
This review was too good not to sing.

variables.name: reviewer_first_name
variables.description: Reviewer's first name or initial, used only with written permission

variables.name: review_line_one
variables.description: First phrase of the real review, unedited
variables.example: I used to dread the dentist

variables.name: review_line_two
variables.description: Second phrase of the real review, unedited
variables.example: now I actually look forward to my cleanings

variables.name: review_hook
variables.description: The most singable 3-6 words from the review

beats.voiceover: {{reviewer_first_name}} left us a review. So we sang it.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a phone in a hand showing a five-star review screen, blurred warm interior of {{brand}} behind, soft light
Vertical slow push-in on a singer at a vintage mic in a warm, empty studio, soft amber light, eyes closed, 9:16
Vertical photo of the welcoming front desk at {{brand}}, staff smiling, natural daylight, no customer faces
Vertical close-up of the singer smiling mid-note, gold backlight, lyric space in the lower third

slides.headline: Verse two

craft.technique: Found-lyric chorus (lift the hook from the customer's own words)
craft.notes: Keep the reviewer's words exactly; the songwriting is in phrasing, not rewriting. Pick the 3-6 words that already carry a natural stress pattern (look FOR-ward TO it) and loop them as the chorus so the title is the customer's phrase. Sing the verse lines rubato with the last stressed syllable held over the bar line, then lock to a steady groove for the chorus. Suggested tempo/feel: 72-80 BPM soul or gospel-lite, Rhodes piano, brushed snare, warm harmony on the repeated hook.

do_not: Edit, combine or invent review words; it must be a real, unpaid, verifiable review
Show a reviewer's face or full name without written consent
Pick a review that mentions a specific medical or financial result
compliance: All niches: use only real reviews with the reviewer's written permission; disclose if the reviewer received anything of value (FTC endorsement guides)
Dental and chiropractor: never reveal patient health information beyond what the patient authorized in writing (HIPAA); no claims of guaranteed or typical results
Financial advisor: testimonials must follow the SEC Marketing Rule (disclose whether the person is a client and any compensation); no performance or income claims
Real estate: include brokerage name and license info per state rules; no implied guaranteed sale price or timeline
